significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish both a form-(iii) predictive coupling—models are "more accurate when [their] internal electron-flow representation matches the ground-truth mechanism"—and a form-(ii) causal mechanism in which patching the "nucleophile-electrophile pairing" switches product regiochemistry. This would connect three mechanistic variables—nucleophile/electrophile roles and bonds formed or broken—to behavior, constraining explanations of reaction-transformer success more strongly than atom correspondence alone; RXNMapper (Schwaller et al., Science Advances, 2021) illustrates that attention-derived atom mapping is already a practically consequential representation in this research line. The true and false states are distinguishable: a verified false result would rule out the stated joint account that electron-flow fidelity predicts correctness and causally controls regiochemistry, although isolated probe failures would be less informative. After topic substitution, the score falls materially because the specific predictive coupling and regiochemical intervention—not merely investigating scientific mechanisms—support the above-median rating.

reach.justification: The named handles are the diagnostic of whether "decoded electron flow matches ground truth" and the intervention that patches "attention corresponding to the identified nucleophile-electrophile pairing"; the former is primarily post hoc because it requires a known annotated mechanism, while the latter is a model-control knob rather than an advance warning. After re-extraction on another reaction transformer, the claim predicts a transferable qualitative relation—greater product accuracy when decoded flow matches the mechanism—but does not provide a cross-model quantitative threshold, and the particular attention structure would still need rediscovery. The asserted scope covers reaction-prediction transformers and "reaction classes underrepresented in training," giving potential uptake by model auditors and synthesis-planning researchers, but not a directly deployable per-reaction screen where the ground-truth mechanism is unknown. Topic substitution would not retain this score: the electron-flow agreement diagnostic, transferable accuracy coupling, and regiochemical patching handle are specific additions beyond the broad scientific-representation topic.
